description: This is a Python source file implementing core game logic, database interactions, and API functions for a Tic Tac Toe game platform. It includes functions for game creation, joining games, making moves, retrieving game statuses, and managing leaderboards.

methods.name: str initial_board()
methods.description: Returns the initial empty Tic Tac Toe board as a string.

methods.name: List[str] board_to_list(board: str)
methods.description: Converts a board string to a list of characters.

methods.name: str list_to_board(lst: List[str])
methods.description: Converts a list of characters to a board string.

methods.name: Optional[str] check_winner(board: str)
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner on the board, returns 'X', 'O', or None.

methods.name: bool board_full(board: str)
methods.description: Checks if the board is full with no empty spaces.

methods.name: int create_game(player_x_id: int)
methods.description: Creates a new game record in the database and returns the game ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] join_game(player_id: int, game_id: int)
methods.description: Allows a player to join an existing waiting game as player_o.

methods.name: List[dict] get_available_games()
methods.description: Fetches games that are waiting for a second player.

methods.name: dict get_game_status(game_id: int, req_user: int)
methods.description: Returns the current status and moves of a specific game.

methods.name: dict make_move(game_id: int, player_id: int, cell_pos: int, symbol: str)
methods.description: Validates and applies a move, updates game state, and handles game conclusion and leaderboard updates.

methods.name: List[LeaderboardEntry] get_leaderboard(limit=10)
methods.description: Retrieves the top players ordered by number of wins.

methods.name: List[GameSummary] get_match_history(user_id: int)
methods.description: Provides recent finished games involving a specific user.

ctags.pattern: /^async def join_game(player_id: int, game_id: int) -> Optional[dict]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^async def make_move(game_id: int, player_id: int, cell_pos: int, symbol: str) -> dict:$/
